parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1420 | 1.44 | 1.44
2 | 859 | 1.49 | 2.93
3 | 987 | 14.5 | 17.4
4 | 2246 | 33.5 | 50.9
5 | 34337 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HAK-type
Aquifer depth: 17.4 m – 50.9 m
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive, thick sandy layer (2246 ohm-m) between 17.4 m and 50.9 m depth as the primary aquifer zone for screen placement; drilling beyond 50.9 m into the very high resistivity layer (34,337 ohm-m) should be approached with caution, as it likely represents a dry/compact or poorly productive formation rather than a saturated aquifer.
